meta.name: xlsx
meta.description: Use this skill any time a spreadsheet file is the primary input or output. This means any task where the user wants to: open, read, edit, or fix an existing .xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx, .csv, or .tsv file (e.g., adding columns, computing formulas, formatting, charting, cleaning messy data); create a new spreadsheet from scratch or from other data sources; or convert between tabular file formats. Trigger especially when the user references a spreadsheet file by name or path — even casually (like "the xlsx in my downloads") — and wants something done to it or produced from it. Also trigger for cleaning or restructuring messy tabular data files (malformed rows, misplaced headers, junk data) into proper spreadsheets. The deliverable must be a spreadsheet file. Do NOT trigger when the primary deliverable is a Word document, HTML report, standalone Python script, database pipeline, or Google Sheets API integration, even if tabular data is involved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Open, edit, create, and convert spreadsheet files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently work with Excel or CSV files

howto.what: Claude 会直接创建、读取、修改 .xlsx/.xlsm/.csv/.tsv 等表格文件，可加列、写公式、排版、转换格式，交付物仍是表格文件。
howto.when: 当你按名字或路径提到某个表格文件（哪怕是随口一句「下载里的 xlsx」）并要对它做点什么，或要求清洗、转换表格数据时触发。交付物必须是表格文件；若最终产物是 Word 文档、HTML 报告或脚本，则不触发。

say.text: 把这个 xlsx 的公式重算一遍，看有没有错误
say.note: 会重算公式并列出出错的单元格

say.text: 在 downloads 里的 xlsx 加一列，算出每行总额
say.note: 写入可重算的公式，而不是写死数字

say.text: 把这些 csv 里错位的表头和乱数据整理成规范表格
say.note: 整理后仍输出表格文件

howto.what_en: Claude creates, reads and edits spreadsheet files (.xlsx, .xlsm, .csv, .tsv): adds columns, writes formulas, formats, converts formats, cleans messy data. Output is a spreadsheet file, with real formulas instead of hardcoded values.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you name a spreadsheet file (even casually) and want it read, edited or produced, or when messy tabular data needs cleaning. Output must be a spreadsheet file.

say_en.text: Recalculate the formulas in this xlsx and check for errors.
say_en.note: Runs recalc and reports error cells

say_en.text: Add a total column to the xlsx in my downloads.
say_en.note: Writes live formulas, not hardcoded values

say_en.text: Clean up the misplaced headers in these csv files into a proper table.
